text: Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College (AKGEC) is affiliated to Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow, UP. College Code - 027. Address: 27th Km Milestone, Delhi-Meerut Expressway, P.O. Adhyatmik Nagar, Ghaziabad - 201015. Phone: 8744052891-93. The college was established in 1998 and offers B.Tech courses in all major disciplines of Engineering. The college also offers M.Tech in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical and Electronics Engineering and Mechanical Engineering. It has 14+ Programs, 15+ R&D Centers, and 5K+ Students. Featured Courses: - B.Tech: CSE, IT, CSE (AI&ML), CSE (DS), CS (Hindi), ECE, ME, EN, CE — 1320 sanctioned intake. - Master of Computer Applications (MCA) — 120 sanctioned intake. - M.Tech: CSE, ECE, EN, ME — 51 sanctioned intake. AKGEC's placement cell focuses on maximizing career prospects for each student. Recruiters include Wipro, Samsung, NIIT, Tech Mahindra, Lava, HCL, and others. OUR VISION: To introduce undergraduate and postgraduate courses for all engineering branches and award of Ph.D degree, to be one of the best engineering colleges in the country and to be a deemed university. OUR MISSION: We strive to provide and maintain academic environment and systems, enabling maximum learning to produce competent professionals. We also aim at achieving this through transparent academic and administrative policies in the college. We intend to provide a conducive atmosphere for research, development and consultancy services to our faculty at national and international level. OUR QUALITY POLICY: To provide and continually improve academic environment and systems which give total satisfaction and enable students to develop their full potential and mature into competent professionals and responsible members of society.

Dr. Hemant Ahuja is the Director of Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College, Ghaziabad. He holds an M.Tech (IIT Delhi) and Ph.D. (IIT Delhi), with over 22 years in academia and industry. He graduated with honors in Electrical Engineering from Kurukshetra University in 2001, completed an M.Tech in Energy and Environmental Management from IIT Delhi in 2008 (awarded the Prof. O.P. Gupta Gold Medal for highest CGPA), and earned his PhD from IIT Delhi in 2013. His expertise is in Electrical Machines, Power Electronics, and Wind Energy Conversion Systems. He has over 50 publications in international journals and conferences, several patents, and has led two research projects funded under TEQIP-III. He is a member of IEEE, PES, ISTE, and IEI, collaborates with the IEI-Ghaziabad local centre, and serves on the Board of Studies for Electrical Engineering at AKTU.
